acq.addBesideHint: Keep a release that wins on formats and loses on quality next to the file, instead of refusing it.
acq.blocklistEmptyHint: A release lands here when its download fails or is removed from the client.
acq.blocklistHint: A download that failed puts its release out of reach, on every indexer that offers it.
acq.condition.subtitle: Subtitles
acq.conditionRequiredHint: Has to hold, whatever the others say.
acq.cutoffEmptyHint: No monitored title holds a copy its profile would still improve.
acq.cutoffHint: Monitored titles holding a copy their profile would still improve.
acq.formatDeleteHint: Profiles that scored it lose that score.
acq.formatMatchRule: Every required condition holds, and per condition type at least one of the others.
acq.formatScoresHint: What each format is worth to this profile. One left at zero counts for nothing.
acq.formatsEmptyHint: Write one to score HDR, a dub or a group.
acq.formatsHint: A format is a named test on a release or a file, and a profile decides what it is worth.
acq.ladderHint: Best first. A rung that is off is refused whatever it scores, and the cutoff is where quality upgrades stop.
acq.minFormatScoreHint: A release scoring under this is refused.
acq.minSeedersHint: A release with fewer seeders is refused.
acq.minUpgradeIncrementHint: How much better a release must score to replace a file of the same quality.
acq.notMonitoredHint: A search still works from here. Monitor it and the automatic pass fills and upgrades it on its own.
acq.profileDeleteHint: Titles that named it go back to the default profile.
acq.profileEditHint: Which qualities this profile accepts, and what each format is worth to it.
acq.profilesHint: A profile ranks the qualities, scores the formats and decides when a copy is good enough. A monitored title follows the default one unless it names another.
acq.sizesBad: A value cannot be read, or a range is out of order.
acq.sizesHint: In megabytes per minute of runtime, so one limit fits a 22-minute episode and a three-hour film. A blank cell is no limit.
acq.sizesRuntimeHint: Used when the metadata gives no runtime.
acq.termsHint: One term per line, matched whole in the release name.
acq.testHint: Nothing is grabbed: this reads the name and shows what each profile would make of it.
acq.titleNoFilesHint: Search for a copy and it will be judged here.
acq.titleRulesFailed: Could not read the rules for this title
acq.upgradeUntilScoreHint: Once a file reaches this score, format upgrades stop.
acq.upgradesAllowedHint: Off, a file on disk is never replaced.
